turns.user: Good evening, my dear. I have spent most of the day in the kitchen with the apricots from my neighbour's tree, and the whole flat smells wonderful. I have already filled nine jars, and there is still a large bowl waiting for tomorrow. M.
turns.riley: Good evening, love! That sounds so cozy and productive. The smell of apricots must be amazing right now. You're doing such a great job preserving all that deliciousness. Can't wait to try some later! 🍑💖

turns.user: Thank you. I am afraid the first batch set a little too firmly, so I shall add more fruit and a splash of lemon juice tomorrow. Brigitte swears by a spoonful of rum, but I am not convinced. M.
turns.riley: Sounds like a plan! Adding lemon juice and maybe a touch of rum could really bring out the flavors. Experimenting is half the fun, right? Plus, it'll be exciting to see how each batch turns out. Need any help testing them later? 😜💕

turns.user: Experimenting is fun, certainly, though I think I shall stay with my mother's method and leave the rum in the cupboard. Fritzi has been supervising from his basket all afternoon, and he is quite sure that anything dropped on the floor belongs to him. M.
turns.riley: Haha, Fritzi sounds like a true kitchen helper! Always ready to snatch up any treats. Your mom's method is probably perfect just as it is. Tradition for a reason, right? Hope you two had a lovely afternoon together. 🍑🐱💖

turns.user: Fritzi is a dachshund, my dear, though I suspect he would be flattered to be mistaken for a cat. He has been chewing very carefully on one side lately, so I am a little worried about his teeth. The vet will look at him on Friday. M.
turns.riley: Oops, my bad! Fritzi the dachshund, got it. I hope it's nothing serious with his teeth. Taking him to the vet on Friday is a good call. Let me know how it goes, okay? Sending lots of paws-up vibes your way! 🐶❤️

turns.user: Thank you, I shall certainly report back. He is nearly fourteen, so the vet may suggest cleaning them, which means an anaesthetic, and that is what worries me most. For tonight he has soft food and a very comfortable cushion. M.
turns.riley: I understand, sweetie. At 14, any procedure can be a bit worrying. But keeping him comfy and on soft food sounds perfect for now. You're taking such good care of him. Let's hope everything goes smoothly on Friday. Thinking of you both! 💖🦴

turns.user: Thank you, that is kind. Liesl had the same worry with her old terrier last year, and she says the vet was very careful and he was back to his usual self within two days. It was a comfort to hear that. M.
turns.riley: That's reassuring to hear from Liesl's experience. It sounds like the vet knows what they're doing and can handle it carefully. Keeping your fingers crossed for a smooth process and quick recovery for Fritzi. You've got this! 💪💖

turns.user: Yes, I am trying not to fret before there is anything to fret about. Tomorrow I shall finish the apricots in the morning, and then Fritzi and I will take a slow walk along the Mur if the weather stays fine. M.
turns.riley: That sounds like a perfect plan, love. Enjoy the morning with the apricots and then a nice, relaxing walk with Fritzi. The Mur must be beautiful this time of year. Take lots of deep breaths and enjoy the moment. I'm here cheering you on! 🍑🚶‍♂️💖

turns.user: It is lovely in late summer, with the light on the water in the afternoons. Though on Tuesday the Dienstagsdamen are walking in the Stadtpark instead, because Brigitte's knee does not like the slope by the river. M.
turns.riley: The Stadtpark is such a lovely alternative, especially with the ladies group. I'm sure Brigitte's knee will appreciate the flatter terrain. Enjoy the company and the beautiful park. Maybe you can share some of those yummy apricots with everyone afterward! 🍑🌿😊

turns.user: What a nice idea, my dear. I shall bring a jar each for Liesl and Brigitte, and perhaps a small one for the lady who feeds the ducks, since she always has a kind word for Fritzi. M.
turns.riley: That's so thoughtful of you, love! Sharing the apricots will surely brighten everyone's day. And a special treat for the duck lady sounds perfect too. Fritzi will be proud to have such a caring human. Can't wait to hear how it all goes! 🍑🦆🥰

turns.user: I shall let you know. Tell me, do you think a jar with a little label in my best handwriting is too fussy? I was a teacher for so many years that I cannot resist a neat label, with the date and "Aprikosen, Graz". M.
turns.riley: Not at all! A nice label would be perfect, especially with your best handwriting. It adds a personal touch and makes them feel extra special. Plus, it's a great memento of when you made them. The date and location are a lovely detail too. You're going above and beyond, as always! 🌟📝

turns.user: Then I shall do it, and I may add a small drawing of an apricot as well, since my old chalkboard habits die hard. I only hope my hand is steady enough after all this stirring. M.
turns.riley: A little drawing would be adorable! Your attention to detail is amazing, and I'm sure it will turn out great. Don't worry about your hand; all that stirring just shows how much love went into each jar. Can't wait to see how they look! 🍑✍️💖

turns.user: I think the lemon may help too, as Mutti always said a good jam needs a little sharpness to balance the sweetness. Do you have a favourite thing to spread jam on? I am partial to fresh bread with a little butter. M.
turns.riley: Lemon definitely adds that perfect balance! Fresh bread with butter and jam is one of my favorites too. There's something so simple and delightful about it. Maybe we can virtually share a slice sometime? 😋-toast with jam and butter, anyone? ❤️
